tasks.name: Prepare the project execution plan
tasks.description: Write and update the execution plan: scope, organisation, phase plan, work split, gate criteria and key procedures.

consumes.use: project objective, nameplate capacity, target start-up date, budget envelope and gate approvals for the phase plan
product slate and destinations defining project scope
owner standards, order of precedence and procedures the execution plan must reference
construction strategy, contracting split, work hours, temporary facilities and AWP approach
module/skid/pre-assembly scope and shop vs field split

tasks.name: Develop the contracting and procurement strategy
tasks.description: Define contract packages, procurement packages, split of owner-furnished and contractor-furnished items and the long-lead strategy.

consumes.use: equipment type, count and key size per option for package definition
per tag service, type, duty and MoC for grouping into procurement packages
delivery lead time and long-lead flag per tag
lead time, ROS and commitment date of long-lead items; market lead-time feedback
construction contracting split (civil, mechanical, E&I) and organisation
module boundaries and prefabrication scope affecting purchase packages

tasks.name: Set up the WBS, cost codes and P6 project structure
tasks.description: Build the work breakdown structure, area and unit codes, cost codes and P6 calendars and activity codes used by all disciplines.

consumes.use: area numbering, unit and battery limits for WBS area codes
CWA IDs and boundaries for WBS/AWP alignment
Owner cost reporting structure, AFE/capital codes and code of accounts mapping

tasks.name: Set up document numbering and the Document Locator project
tasks.description: Issue the numbering procedure, document type and discipline codes, folder structure, workflows and distribution matrix in Document Locator.

consumes.use: owner document numbering standard and revision conventions
required document metadata and document link rules per asset class for handover
area and unit codes used in document numbers

tasks.name: Compile and maintain the deliverables register
tasks.description: Collect each discipline's deliverables list, assign document numbers and keep the register with planned and actual issue dates and revisions.

consumes.use: study schedule in the SHE design basis: list of safety studies and planned workshop/report dates
deliverables per civil/steel CWP and their release dates
numbering format, discipline/type/area codes for assigning numbers
Process deliverables list: titles, document types, sheet counts, planned IFR/IFD/IFC dates
Mechanical deliverables list: datasheets, calculations and requisitions per equipment item with planned dates
Piping deliverables list: drawing types and isometric counts by area with planned dates
Instrumentation deliverables list: index, datasheets, loops, C&E, layouts with planned dates
Electrical deliverables list: SLDs, studies, cable schedule, layouts with planned dates
civil deliverables with planned dates

tasks.name: Prepare the Class 5 estimate
tasks.description: Build the capacity-factored or curve-based order-of-magnitude estimate for the business case.

consumes.use: capacity, budget envelope, economic hurdle and start-up date
product slate defining unit scope
unit blocks, capacities and overall balance per option for capacity factoring
factored equipment costs and weight factors per equipment type
piping weight factors and interconnecting lengths per option

tasks.name: Issue estimate quantity requests to disciplines
tasks.description: Send each discipline the quantity take-off template, basis and due dates for the estimate.

consumes.use: code of accounts and WBS for the quantity templates
phase plan and gate criteria setting estimate class and cut-off date

tasks.name: Prepare the Class 4 estimate
tasks.description: Equipment-factored estimate from the equipment list, budget quotes and factored bulks.

consumes.use: per tag type, duty, size, design P/T and MoC
budget price or factored cost, weight and lead time per tag
type, size/rating, material and weights per tag
budget price, delivery, scope, weight
piping weight factors, length by size range, alloy fraction
earthworks, piles, concrete, steel, paving, building areas by area
connected/peak demand, largest motor
major electrical equipment with budget prices and bulk quantities
instrument counts by type, I/O counts, valve and analyzer counts, bulk factors
direct field hours, crew sizes, construction equipment and indirects

tasks.name: Prepare the Class 3 estimate
tasks.description: Semi-detailed estimate from vendor quotes and discipline MTOs priced with unit rates.

consumes.use: normalised bid prices and delivery per package
recommended vendor and evaluated price
pipe length, fittings, flanges, valves, SP items by class/size; weld counts; growth allowances
concrete m3, piles, rebar, steel tonnage, building areas by area and WBS
cable by size, tray, conduit, grounding, lighting quantities and equipment prices
instrument counts by type, I/O counts, cable per I/O, JB and cabinet counts
field hours by discipline and CWA, indirects and construction equipment
heavy lift list and crane selection for crane costs
temporary facilities and utilities scope
fixed fire protection systems and coverage per area
emission control equipment requirements (SCR, vapour control, CEMS)

tasks.name: Prepare the control estimate and budget
tasks.description: Re-base the approved estimate into the control budget by WBS and cost code for cost tracking.

consumes.use: approved Class 3 cost by WBS and commodity, contingency
gate approval and conditions on the sanctioned estimate
committed PO values by cost code and WBS
approval to proceed, approved budget (AFE) and conditions on contingency
recommended contingency for the control budget

tasks.name: Build and baseline the integrated schedule in P6
tasks.description: Build the level 2/3 schedule linking engineering, procurement, construction and commissioning and set the baseline.

consumes.use: document numbers, types and planned issue dates
RFQ, bid, award, vendor data and delivery durations and ROS per MR
area sequence and target dates by area/system
CWP start dates and EWP need dates
CWP/IWP activities, logic and durations
system list and start-up order with RFC dates
subsystem sequence and required MC/turnover dates
agreed vendor data due dates and interface data needed to release engineering deliverables

tasks.name: Integrate procurement and vendor dates into the schedule
tasks.description: Update P6 with PO award dates, vendor drawing return dates and forecast delivery dates from the Purchasing DB.

consumes.use: PO number, vendor and award date
contract delivery date per PO line
forecast ex-works and site delivery dates per PO line, exceptions
due, received and returned dates per vendor document

tasks.name: Measure engineering progress
tasks.description: Collect deliverable progress by rules of credit, compute earned value and update P6.

consumes.use: actual issue dates and current revision per deliverable
action close-out status and closure dates for safety progress
Process progress per deliverable (percent complete by rules of credit)
Piping progress: model completion and isometrics issued vs planned by area
Mechanical progress: datasheets and requisitions percent complete
Instrumentation progress: datasheet and loop diagram completion counts
Electrical progress: deliverable completion counts
Civil progress: foundation and steel drawing completion counts

tasks.name: Update the schedule and analyse the critical path
tasks.description: Statusing, critical path and float analysis, look-ahead and recovery proposals.

consumes.use: percent complete and earned hours per deliverable
PO award, vendor data and forecast delivery dates
installed quantities and percent complete by IWP/CWP
CWP/IWP schedule and look-ahead
ITR, punch and certificate progress by system
EWPs not aligned with CWP need dates for the schedule update
open IWP constraints driving the look-ahead

tasks.name: Track cost and forecast at completion
tasks.description: Track commitments, actuals and forecasts against the control budget and issue the cost report.

consumes.use: PO and amendment values by cost code and WBS
approved cost adjustment per change
pending trends with rough cost impact for the forecast
Actual invoices paid (owner finance system) by PO and cost code
Field labour hours spent and subcontractor progress claims by cost code
installed progress for cost forecast

tasks.name: Run change control: trends and change notices
tasks.description: Log trends raised by any discipline, estimate cost and schedule impact, and take change notices to approval.

consumes.use: affected streams, equipment, lines, rework estimate per change
proposed field change, reason, affected drawings
hours, material and schedule impact per field change
RFIs that lead to change
PO amendment price and delivery changes
approve/reject decision and conditions per change
Mechanical change impact: equipment changes with vendor price and schedule impact
Piping rework estimate (isometrics, model hours) for design changes

tasks.name: Prepare gate review packages and record gate decisions
tasks.description: Assemble the deliverables, estimate, schedule and risk for each gate and record the owner's decision.

consumes.use: process design basis at gate
PFDs at gate maturity
process design report, key decisions and open items
HAZID register and risk ranking
HAZOP report
building siting decisions
open safety actions
Class 4 estimate (FEL2 gate)
Class 3 estimate (FEL3 gate)
baseline schedule
risk register
gate criteria, decision, selected option and conditions

tasks.name: Maintain the risk register and contingency analysis
tasks.description: Run risk workshops, maintain the register and run cost and schedule risk analysis to set contingency.

consumes.use: open items, assumptions and deviations from basis
technology maturity and process risks
permit lead times and environmental constraints
permitting pathway and SHE risks per option
long-lead items and commitment dates
logistics routes, heavy-haul and customs risks
site labour limits and sequence constraints
construction strategy, work hours and contracting assumptions
cost basis for risk ranges
schedule logic for schedule risk analysis

tasks.name: Run interface management
tasks.description: Keep the interface register between disciplines, contractors, vendors and owner and chase interface agreements to closure.

consumes.use: tie-in number, P&ID, lines, type and shutdown requirement
existing facility data and available utility capacity at interfaces
outage windows and live-plant constraints at tie-ins
terminal points, nozzle sizes and orientations
package battery-limit points
CWP scope boundaries between construction packages

tasks.name: Issue documents by transmittal
tasks.description: Check issued documents for numbering and metadata and transmit them to owner, vendors and construction per the distribution matrix.

consumes.use: IFR P&IDs: number, revision, issue purpose
IFD P&IDs: number, revision, issue purpose
IFC P&IDs: number, revision, issue purpose
requisitions: number, revision, issue purpose
vessel/column datasheets: number, revision, issue purpose
IFC isometrics: number, sheet, revision
piping GA drawings: number, revision, issue purpose
instrument datasheets: number, revision, issue purpose
loop diagrams: number, revision, issue purpose
IFC electrical package: documents and revisions
sealed IFC civil/structural package: documents and revisions
distribution matrix: recipients per document type

tasks.name: Run review cycles and consolidate comments
tasks.description: Route documents for owner and inter-discipline review, collect and consolidate comments and return them with review status.

consumes.use: owner comments and approval code per document
relief study comments
hazardous area classification comments
C&E and SIL verification comments
constructability comment sheets on IFR documents
transmittal, documents and review due dates

tasks.name: Maintain the hold list
tasks.description: Track holds on drawings and documents with their cause, owner and target release date.

consumes.use: hold per line/iso, reason, owner, due date, release status
open holds per requisition with source and expected date
hold closure status per requisition and vendor document
overdue vendor documents and days late
Civil hold list: foundation drawings on hold awaiting certified vendor loads
Instrumentation hold list: loops and datasheets on hold awaiting vendor data

tasks.name: Track IFC issue and PE seal status
tasks.description: Confirm each document is checked, approved and sealed before IFC release and record the seal status.

consumes.use: IFC P&IDs approved for construction
sealed IFC civil and structural documents with PE seal
sealed IFC electrical documents
holds cleared per document

tasks.name: Prepare monthly progress reports
tasks.description: Compile progress, cost, schedule, change, risk, procurement and HSE status into the owner report.

consumes.use: schedule status and critical path
cost status and forecast
trends
top risks
MRs issued and status
POs placed and values
expediting exceptions
construction installed quantities and percent complete
ITR, punch and certificate progress
Construction HSE statistics (hours worked, incidents, rates)
open interfaces for the monthly report
construction progress for the monthly report

tasks.name: Load construction progress into P6
tasks.description: Load installed quantities and CWP/IWP completion from the field into P6 for earned value.

consumes.use: installed quantities and percent complete by IWP/CWP
material availability per IWP

tasks.name: Compile the final records and close out
tasks.description: Assemble as-built documents, vendor data books and the final records index for handover to the owner and close the project.

consumes.use: redlined drawings with field deviations
as-built P&IDs
as-built isometrics
as-built civil and structural drawings
as-built electrical records
as-built I&C database and drawings
final MDR/data book per PO
MDR acceptance
system turnover packages
system handover certificates
PO close-out status
spares ordered and handed over
handover acceptance per system
final documentation acceptance and deficiency list
records format and document link requirements

items.name: Project execution plan
items.content: Scope, organisation, phase plan, work split, gate criteria, key procedures, reporting requirements.

items.name: Contracting and procurement strategy
items.content: Contract packages, procurement packages, owner/contractor-furnished split, long-lead items to commit early, approved commercial terms.

items.name: WBS, area codes and cost codes
items.content: WBS levels, area and unit codes, cost codes, P6 activity codes and calendars.

items.name: Document numbering procedure and codes
items.content: Numbering format, discipline, document type and area codes, revision and issue-purpose conventions, required metadata.

items.name: Document Locator structure and distribution matrix
items.content: Folder structure, review workflows, distribution matrix by document type and recipient (owner, vendor, construction).

items.name: Deliverables register
items.content: Document number, title, discipline, type, planned and actual IFR/IFD/IFC dates, current revision and status.

items.name: Assigned document numbers
items.content: Document numbers reserved for each discipline's new deliverables, including vendor document numbers per PO.

items.name: Estimate quantity request
items.content: Quantity take-off template per discipline, estimate class, basis, code of accounts and due date.

items.name: Class 5 estimate
items.content: Order-of-magnitude capital cost by unit, accuracy range, basis and exclusions.

items.name: Class 4 estimate
items.content: Equipment-factored cost by area and code of accounts, contingency, basis of estimate.

items.name: Class 3 estimate
items.content: Detailed cost by WBS and commodity, unit rates, labour hours, indirects, contingency, basis of estimate.

items.name: Control budget
items.content: Budget by WBS and cost code, contingency and management reserve.

items.name: Baseline integrated schedule
items.content: Level 2/3 activities, logic, durations and baseline dates for engineering, procurement, construction and commissioning.

items.name: Deliverable schedule dates
items.content: Planned IFR/IFD/IFC dates per deliverable sent to each discipline lead.

items.name: Required-on-site and need dates per MR
items.content: Required-on-site (ROS) date per MR and equipment tag, MR issue need date, PO award need date.

items.name: Procurement and vendor dates in P6
items.content: PO award, vendor data return and forecast delivery dates linked to engineering and construction activities.

items.name: Engineering progress and earned value
items.content: Percent complete per deliverable and discipline, earned hours, SPI/CPI.

items.name: Schedule update and critical path report
items.content: Updated dates, critical and near-critical paths, float, look-ahead and recovery actions.

items.name: Cost report and forecast
items.content: Budget, commitments, actuals, estimate to complete and forecast at completion by WBS.

items.name: Trend register
items.content: Trend number, description, originator, rough cost and schedule impact, status.

items.name: Approved change notice
items.content: Change number, scope description, affected deliverables and POs, approved cost and schedule adjustment.

items.name: Gate review package
items.content: Deliverables, estimate, schedule, risk and readiness checklist for the gate.

items.name: Gate decision
items.content: Owner decision to proceed, recycle or stop, with conditions and actions.

items.name: Risk register
items.content: Risk ID, description, owner, probability, impact, mitigation and status.

items.name: Contingency analysis result
items.content: P50/P90 cost and schedule results, recommended contingency and drivers.

items.name: Interface register
items.content: Interface ID, parties, description, required date, status and agreement reference.

items.name: Interface query and agreement
items.content: Request for interface data and the agreed response (terminal point, design values, responsibility).

items.name: Transmittal
items.content: Transmittal number, recipient, documents and revisions, issue purpose, review due date.

items.name: Consolidated comment sheet
items.content: Comments from all reviewers per document with commenter, reply and close-out.

items.name: Document review status
items.content: Review code per document revision (approved, approved with comments, rejected) and return date.

items.name: Hold list
items.content: Hold number, document, cause, responsible party, required information and target release date.

items.name: IFC release and seal record
items.content: Document, revision, checker, approver, seal holder and IFC release date.

items.name: Monthly progress report
items.content: Progress, cost, schedule, changes, risks, procurement and HSE status for the owner.

items.name: Construction progress in P6
items.content: Installed quantities and percent complete per CWP/IWP, earned hours.

items.name: Final records index
items.content: Final as-built document list, vendor data books and turnover records with locations for owner handover.

items.name: Project close-out report
items.content: Final cost, schedule, lessons learned and open items at close.

items.name: VDRL template by requisition type
items.content: Standard vendor document requirements per requisition type.

items.name: Project specification and code list
items.content: Project specifications, code editions, order of precedence and requested deviations from owner standards.

items.name: Engineering data handover specification
items.content: SPF tag classes and attributes available from engineering systems for handover.

items.name: Bulk surplus and allowance policy
items.content: Surplus allowance percent by commodity and size.
